messages:
Priya: quick ping — PR #3421 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is up for docs review. Needs 2 reviewers and a preview link. Posting the preview shortly.
Sam: thanks — assigning @Kai and @Elaine as reviewers? Kai handled migrations last quarter.
Kai: happy to review. I'll check terminology (model -> model family?) and inline code examples for accuracy.
Elaine: can we also check voice/tone for the 'we recommend' phrasing — prefer 'consider' per style guide. small nit: avoid 'just'.
docs-bot: Preview built: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/3421 — link-check ok, but CI has a failing lint (docs/format) :x: 
Priya: noted. @Justin can you take the lint fix? it's a small markdown list indent.
Justin: on it. will push a commit shortly. also will fix the broken anchor link reported by the bot.
Maria: FYI, the SDK snippet needs sync for the Python example — uses old client call `client.generate()` => should be `client.text.generate()` per new SDK.
Sam: good catch @Maria — that's a terminology + API accuracy issue. Marking as blocker for merge.
Kai: review comments: change 'model' -> 'model family' in section 'Choosing a model', update variable names in code samples to follow snake_case, and add a short expected-output block for the example.
Elaine: also, tone: the migration section reads prescriptive. Change 'You must' -> 'We recommend' unless it's an actual requirement. See style guide excerpt: 'avoid imperative unless required.'
Priya: can we gate merge until 3pm PT? We're coordinating with the release window. If everything green, we can merge at 15:00 PT.
docs-bot: CI status: lint failed -> pending, preview updated after Justin's push at 2036543240.
Justin: pushed fixes. ran `yarn docs:preview` locally and `make lint-fix`.
Kai: re-reviewed. LGTM on content & tone. One minor nit left about an Oxford comma — not blocking.
Elaine: approving for tone. @Sam can you give final signage for doc ownership? then we can merge during the 3pm slot.
Sam: approved for merge. remind me 10 min before.
Priya: will merge at 2036543400 (3pm PT) if no further issues. please add a short changelog entry in the PR body about API snippet update.
Maria: added changelog line. also updated the Python snippet: ```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.text.generate("migrate this config")
print(resp.text)
```
Priya: thanks! everyone — great quick turnaround. If any regressions in the preview after merge, we'll rollback and open an emergency docs PR.
docs-bot: Merged at 2036543410 by Priya. Release notes: docs update + SDK example sync.
Sam: :tada:
